root_cause.text: In `mana_gd_cleanup()`, the `gc->service_wq` pointer was not set to NULL after `destroy_workqueue()`, allowing a subsequent call to `mana_gd_cleanup()` (via `mana_gd_remove()` on the error path of `mana_serv_reset()`) to attempt to destroy the already-freed workqueue, causing a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The patch description explicitly states that `mana_gd_cleanup()` destroys the workqueue without NULL-check; later `mana_gd_remove()` calls it again, leading to double destroy. The fix adds `if (gc->service_wq)` before destroying and sets `gc->service_wq = NULL` after destruction.
